Schema & Entity Valid?
- Known Entity ID?
- Valid Timestamp?
- Physical Quantity >= 0?
- Valid Status Transition?

Status = 'invalid'
(Record raw claim, do not apply)

Status = 'conflict'
(Idempotency key reused with new data)

Specific Integration Connection Offline?
(carrier / warehouse / supplier)

Status = 'queued'
(Buffer in integration inbox for targeted replay)
Contradictory Accepted Event at Same Time?

Status = 'accepted'
- Advance state.clock if time > clock
- Execute applyAccepted()
